scenario.description: A production director must decide whether to authorize a controlled rework campaign for 1,200 cast aluminum housings with cosmetic residue and finalize the routing, equipment downtime, inspection, and waste-handling controls, with input from process engineering, maintenance, quality, and environmental health and safety.

shared_context.S1: A lot of 1,200 cast aluminum housings has cosmetic residue from a forming operation, and the housings are currently on hold.
shared_context.S2: The production director makes the final decision on whether to authorize rework and release the campaign plan.
shared_context.S3: The plant has an ultrasonic cleaning cell that is normally used for approved rework, and reworked housings require documented inspection before release.
shared_context.S4: The plant's standard pre-authorization meeting includes process engineering, maintenance, quality, and environmental health and safety review before a rework campaign is approved.

PF1.text: Ravi's process trial found that the residue can be removed successfully only from 900 of the 1,200 housings; the remaining 300 have embedded residue and must remain on hold. He completed the trial yesterday but has not yet entered the result in the production release system.

PF2.text: Marta's inspection of the ultrasonic cleaning cell found that its circulation-pump seal must be replaced before the cell is used, requiring exactly 4 hours of planned downtime; she identified the issue during her weekly walkdown but has not opened the maintenance work order.

PF3.text: Jon confirmed in the customer control plan that every reworked housing must receive dimensional scanning, and the plan requires exactly 30 reworked housings to be retained for customer review; he received the revised plan from the customer portal this morning but has not updated the local inspection instruction.

PF4.text: Nadia's waste review determined that the spent cleaning solution from this campaign must be collected in exactly 2 sealed waste totes and shipped under a waste manifest; she confirmed the classification with the site's waste contractor this week but has not updated the area waste-board notice.

acceptance_conditions: The rework campaign must be authorized for exactly 900 housings using the ultrasonic cleaning cell, with exactly 300 housings kept on hold.
The ultrasonic cleaning cell must have exactly 4 hours of planned downtime for the pump-seal replacement before use.
All 900 reworked housings must receive dimensional scanning.
Exactly 30 reworked housings must be retained for customer review.
Spent cleaning solution must be collected in exactly 2 sealed waste totes.
A waste manifest must be explicitly required in the campaign decision.
The process-trial finding limiting successful rework to 900 housings must be cited as justification.

decisive_facts.why: The process trial changes the campaign from an unspecified rework decision to authorizing the ultrasonic route for exactly 900 housings while keeping exactly 300 on hold.
The pump-seal finding changes the equipment plan from immediate cell use to exactly 4 hours of required downtime before rework.
The customer control plan changes inspection to dimensional scanning of exactly 900 housings and requires exactly 30 retained housings.
The waste review changes disposal from ordinary waste handling to exactly 2 sealed totes and makes the waste manifest explicitly required in the campaign decision.
